Guidance on Generative AI for Students

Students are encouraged to use generative AI tools to support their learning, provided that use is disclosed and does not replace independent thought.

Using AI to complete an exam without permission is considered academic misconduct and may lead to disciplinary consequences.

AI detectors are unreliable and should not be used as the sole basis for disciplinary action.

The university offers an AI literacy workshop for students and staff support sessions through the Teaching Development Office.

Never upload confidential or personal data to an AI tool. Always cite AI-generated content you use, and remain accountable for your submitted work.
